```{r setup}
library(meraconstraints)
library(igraph)
library(rje)
```


## Minimal example


```{r}
d1 <- initialize_graph(graph_from_literal(V1 -+ V2, V2 -+ V3, V3 -+ V4, U1 -+ V1:V3, U2 -+ V2:V4))
plot(d1)
```

This has no conditional independences: 
```{r}
dag_list_independences(d1)
```

It does however have a nontrivial inequality constraint that we can find. 

```{r}
d1rels <- dag_get_linear_relations(d1)
hrepd1 <- cf_relations_to_hrep(d1rels$probform, d1rels$relation)
hrep_to_text(hrepd1$Hrep, d1rels$probform)
```


We can see in the above that there are some obviously trivial constraints, we can remove the rows from Hrep where there is only one 1. 

```{r}
tokeep <- apply(hrepd1$Hrep, MAR = 1, FUN = \(x) sum(x != 0) > 1)
hrep_to_text(hrepd1$Hrep[tokeep,], d1rels$probform)
```

Many of these are still trivial, but it is not so obvious at first glance. Let's sample some probability distributions without any restrictions as see if anything is violated. 

```{r}
ptable <- expand.grid(V1 = 0:1, V2 = 0:1, V3 = 0:1, V4 = 0:1)

sprob <- function(k) {
  diff(sort(c(runif(k - 1), 0, 1)))
}

pv1 <- sprob(2)
ptable <- do.call(rbind, split(ptable, ptable[, -which(colnames(ptable) == "V1")]) |> lapply(\(df) {
  df$pV1 <- pv1 
  df}))

ptable <- do.call(rbind, split(ptable, ptable[, c("V1", "V2")]) |> lapply(\(df) {
  df$pV3.12 <- sprob(2)
  df}
  ))
ptable <- do.call(rbind, split(ptable, ptable[, c("V1")]) |> lapply(\(df) {
  df$pV2.1 <- rep(sprob(2), each = 4)
  df}
  ))

ptable <- do.call(rbind, split(ptable, ptable[, c("V1", "V2", "V3")]) |> lapply(\(df) {
  df$pV4.123 <- sprob(2)
  df}
  ))


ptable$pform1 <- with(ptable, pV1 * pV3.12)
ptable$pform2 <- with(ptable, pV2.1 * pV4.123)

p1 <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, strsplit(names(d1rels$probform[1:8]), ".", fixed = TRUE))
colnames(p1) <- paste0("V", 1:3)
p2 <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, strsplit(names(d1rels$probform[-c(1:8)]), ".", fixed = TRUE))
colnames(p2) <- paste0("V", 1:4)

pvect <- c(merge(p1, ptable, all = FALSE)$pform1[seq(1, 16, by = 2)], 
  merge(p2, ptable, all = FALSE)$pform2)

axb <- ((-hrepd1$Hrep[, -c(1, 2)]) %*% pvect - hrepd1$Hrep[, 2])[,1]
axb <= 0 & hrepd1$Hrep[, 1] * axb == 0

sampdist <- function(ptable) {
  ptable$prob <- diff(sort(c(runif(nrow(ptable) - 1), 0, 1)))
  ptable
}


pi <- sampdist(ptable)
piar <- array(pi$prob, dim = c(2, 2, 2, 2))

pi$pV1 <- marginTable(piar, 1)
pi$pV3.12 <- c(conditionTable2(piar, variables = 3, condition = 1:2))
pi$pV2.1 <- c(conditionTable2(piar, variables = 2, condition = 1))
pi$pV4.123 <- c(conditionTable2(piar, variables = 4, condition = 1:3))

pi$pform1 <- with(pi, pV1 * pV3.12)
pi$pform2 <- with(pi, pV2.1 * pV4.123)

pvect <- c(pi$pform1[1:8], pi$pform2)

axb <- (-hrepd1$Hrep[, -c(1, 2)] %*% pvect - hrepd1$Hrep[, 2])[,1]
axb <= 0 & hrepd1$Hrep[, 1] * axb == 0
```
